{"subject":"Recap: Corvid replenishment validation, 1 Oct","body":"Hi Ben, Helen and Raymond,

Thanks for the time today. Here is what we covered.

Validated in the sandbox: store sales and ship from store orders merged into one model, refreshed every five minutes, with a replenishment signal and Teams alerts that can also route to district managers. About four percent of SKU rows did not match through your crosswalk; Raymond will look at those.

Open items:
- Tom will send Raymond the exceptions table.
- I will put together a pricing range once Tom has looked at the full store count.
- Seasonality and peak behavior still need to be tested on your history, which Tom said he wants to see before promising results.
- Helen raised the effort for her team. We will come back with a plan that names owners and effort by role, not a guess at weeks.
- Ben is taking the Lakestream question back internally.

No date was set for a next conversation. Would it help if we sent material for that internal discussion?

Elise","customer_value_line":"The merged view of store sales and ship from store orders points toward your goal of store managers knowing by mid afternoon what to reorder, instead of finding out from an empty shelf the next morning.","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U014","excerpt":"Store sales and ship from store orders in one model, updated every five minutes."},{"utterance_id":"U017","excerpt":"About four percent of rows didn't match, they're in this exceptions table."},{"utterance_id":"U048","excerpt":"Yes, you can route by any field you have. District is in your store table so that's easy."},{"utterance_id":"U086","excerpt":"Raymond, I'll send over the exceptions table so you can look at those unmatched rows."},{"utterance_id":"U044","excerpt":"I don't want to throw a number out before Tom has looked at the full store count, but I can put together a range."},{"utterance_id":"U036","excerpt":"I'd want to see it on your history before I promise how well it handles peak."},{"utterance_id":"U072","excerpt":"I don't want to give you a number of weeks off the top of my head, because I'd be guessing"},{"utterance_id":"U058","excerpt":"Okay. I'll take that back."},{"utterance_id":"U013","excerpt":"Right now the replenishment report lands at six the next morning and it's already wrong because online orders that ship from store aren't in it."}]}
